prompt:
Edit this inspected poster into one finished flat opaque 16:9 community poster. Correct the observed composition defect: the large pale wall patches currently function as reserved headline/information panels.

Recompose the existing food-and-listening narrative as a continuous crisp digital ink drawing with luminous amber and green washes. Keep the cropped near-right soup, dishes and reusable cups as the foreground, with seated adult neighbors diminishing along one diagonal toward the modest left-side flute player. Carry the neighbors' shoulders and faces higher into the middle and upper frame, letting overlapping sleeves, chair contours, bowl rims and leaf clusters create an asymmetric moving silhouette. Retain the shared sightlines and clear hands/instruments, the unhurried adult neighborhood mood and the deep blue-green/amber/fresh-green palette. Keep it an anonymous invented gathering without performer or business promotion.

Let lettering be part of the open drawing, threaded through unequal curved spaces produced by the active contours. Remove the broad title-bearing wall and the upper-right information wall entirely; do not replace them with another empty sky, floor, room or rectangular color panel. Continue foreground and receding contour drawing through those areas so there is no upper headline/date panel with a scenic lower illustration. Move the Korean title into the inner bend at middle-left, with the English companion and event description close beneath. The far musician and receding listener contours bound its upper and outer edge. Date/hours sit in a smaller opening near the distant part of the diagonal; venue/entry and purchase/participation occupy two neighboring but unequal spaces beside different listener contours. The cup reminder stays adjacent to near cups, and the invitation follows the lower-left listening contours. Keep horizontal practical text and clear medium humanist Korean sans, broad-pen title with open counters, complete word spacing and sufficient contrast to read every practical line at 720-pixel width. Shapes may surround text but never cross its glyphs. The visual action, changing scale and crop must organize the whole layout rather than merely decorate information fields.

Preserve all eleven existing printed entries exactly once, including Korean spelling, English case, word spaces, dates and times, middle dots, colons and the en dash. Preserve every word of the cup reminder and invitation. Add no printed copy, signs, pseudo-writing, logo, QR or watermark. Keep the digital ink/wash finish clean and coherent, without distressed paper or decorative collage. The exclusion of a passive solid/near-solid/split-color headline-information template with subordinate imagery still applies. Return one flat poster, not a mockup or multi-image panel.
